\section{Two}

{\bf{Lemma 2.1.}} Every compact space is bounded.
\\
\\
{\bf{Proof.}} Cover the space by balls. $\Box$\\
{\bf{Theorem 2.2.}} A closed part of a compact space is compact.\\
Theorem 2.2 says more than it seems. A good tuple is one that fits.\\[5pt] \noindent
\textbf{Claim 1.} Each good tuple is small.
